# axm skills install

Reinstall configured skills from their sources, or install skills from a registry, GitHub, or local path

## When to use

Reinstall configured skills from their sources, or install skills from a registry, GitHub, or local path

## Usage

```bash
axm skills install [flags] [<source>]
```

## Arguments

| Name     | Type   | Required | Description                                                                                |
| -------- | ------ | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `source` | string | No       | Registry reference (@owner/skills/name), GitHub shorthand (owner/repo), local path, or URL |

## Flags

| Name            | Type    | Required | Description                                                                       |
| --------------- | ------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--scope`       | choice  | No       | Install to project (default) or user-level configuration (choices: project, user) |
| `--skill`       | string  | No       | Cherry-pick specific skill(s) from a multi-skill source                           |
| `--all`         | boolean | No       | Install every skill found in the source without prompting                         |
| `--yes`, `-y`   | boolean | No       | Skip confirmation after reviewing the install plan                                |
| `--force`, `-f` | boolean | No       | Reinstall even if the skill already exists                                        |
| `--preview`     | boolean | No       | Show what would be installed without making changes                               |

Global flags are documented on [Global flags](../global-flags).

## Examples

**Reinstall all configured skills from their sources**

```bash
axm skills install
```

**Add a code review skill to your agents**

```bash
axm skills install @acme/skills/code-review
```

**Pin to a specific version range**

```bash
axm skills install @acme/skills/code-review@^1.0.0
```

**Install from a GitHub repository**

```bash
axm skills install owner/repo
```

**Install from a local directory during development**

```bash
axm skills install ./path/to/skills
```

**CI: install all skills without prompts**

```bash
axm skills install owner/repo --all --yes
```

**See what would be installed before committing**

```bash
axm skills install @acme/skills/code-review --preview
```

## Requirements

None.

## Side effects

None.
